Several residents are arrested after riots erupted yesterday in Kobani, Syria, over the murder of a Kurdish citizen that was blamed on an Arab man. Some of those arrested starter a prison riot at the prison, which resulted in a fire that killed seven inmates. The violence erupted over plans to transfer some prisoners to another prison in Aleppo
